## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Berlin, Germany. It starts at Matthäikirchplatz.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Near to the Potsdamer Platz, the Tiergarten and the Philharmonic concert hall of Berlin, the Kupferstichkabinett should be added to your itinerary, too.
>
> At the Kupferstichkabinett, or Museum of Prints and Drawings, you can see a hugely impressive collection of masterpieces by Botticelli, Dürer, Albrecht Altdorfer, Matthias Grünewald, Bruegel the Elder., Rembrandt, Karl Friedrich Schinkel, Friedrich oder Menzel, and more!
>
> Don't miss a look around the museum shop, well-known for its unique and special gift items.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €9.57. It was rated 4.7 out of 5 from 12 ratings and 6 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
